symbols.name: vector space
symbols.meaning: The vector space over $F$ on which the bilinear form and the subspaces are taken.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal V$ be a vector space over $F$ with a bilinear form $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle$ on $\mathcal V$.

symbols.name: larger label
symbols.meaning: The larger of the two labels on an edge, the one that contains the smaller label $U$.
symbols.quote: For such an edge, write $U\subseteq\mathcal L$, where $U$ is the smaller label and $\mathcal L$ the larger.

relations.quote: The orthogonal complement $U^\perp$ of a subspace $U$ (a subset closed under addition and under multiplication by scalars) is defined by a [bilinear form](bilinear-form.md): it is the set of vectors that the form sends to zero against every vector of $U$.
